name: Girlfriend (Kari) - Kimi to Sugosu Natsuyasumi
original_name: ガールフレンド(仮) きみと過ごす夏休み
source: A spin-off game based on Ameba's game apps "Girlfriend (Kari)". In the visual novel game, player takes the role of a male sophomore at Seiou Academy, where the event is currently set on a summer vacation.
translation: 一款基于Ameba游戏应用《女朋友（暂定）》的衍生游戏。在这部视觉小说中，玩家扮演圣央学园的男高中二年级学生，故事发生在暑假。
